name: ghostframe-dev-tools
description: Development tools for the ghostframe mod. Kept out of the plugin root: a package.json with a lockfile there makes Claude Code install dependencies on every user's machine.

scripts.typecheck: cd .. && tsrs -p . && tsrs -p tests && tsrs -p tools && tsrs -p statusline
scripts.boundaries: cd .. && bun tools/scripts/boundaries.ts --self-test && bun tools/scripts/boundaries.ts && bun tools/scripts/screens.ts --check && bun tools/scripts/engines.ts --self-test && bun tools/scripts/engines.ts --check && bun tools/scripts/readme.ts --self-test && bun tools/scripts/readme.ts --check && bun tools/scripts/readme-art.ts --self-test && bun tools/scripts/readme-art.ts --check
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run boundaries && bun run lint && bun run fmt:check && bun run validate && bun run test && bun run test:statusline
